Business mein customer kaise badhaye? Bina ad ke, ye 4 free totke. 🤝

1. Har bill ke saath WhatsApp pe Google review ka link bhejiye.

2. Counter pe board: dost ko laaiye, dono ko 10% off.

3. Jo customer 2 mahine se nahi aaya, use message kijiye: naya stock aaya hai, aapke liye rakha hai.

4. Bagal ki dukaan se card badliye, jo aapka competitor nahi hai.

Aur har naye customer se poochiye, aapke baare mein kahan se pata chala.

Comment mein bataiye, aapke zyada customer kahan se aate hain? 👇
